title: Classic small desk "a/c"- Super small desk personal fan
text: Classic small desk "a/c"- Super small desk personal fan. This is not an air conditioner by any stretch of the imagination.  Is is a very small fan that is the size of your hand to blow in your face.  It is quiet, and does blow a little air.  Don't expect much.

product_metadata.title: Portable Air Conditioner Fan, KUUOTE Mini Evaporative Cooler with 7 Colors Night Light, Personal Space Air Cooler Quiet Desk Fan Humidifier Misting Fan for Small Room Bedroom Home Office
features: 【3 in 1 Portable Air Conditioner Fan】 This portable air conditioner fan can be used as an ordinary desk fan, cool mist humidifier or as an air cooler fan by adding ice and water into tank so you will feel more cooling and fresh wind come out.

【Air Humidification】 With the water tank, continuously spraying for 3-5 hours for one tank water, drop your favorite essential oil into water, the misting air come out to increase the air humidity, purify air and keeps your skin moisture.

【7 Color Lights & Ultra-Quiet】The misting fan is built in 7 soft lights which can bring you a good mood and help you fall asleep better. This ultra-quiet air cooler can work powerfully at a low noise level, make you enjoy a comfortable sleep all night with suitable temperature and low-level noise.

【Upgraded 3 Speed Fan】The portable air cooler fan has 3 adjustable wind speeds, press the power button to choose the soft-cool-strong wind. This electric fan is designed with new air outlet to produce powerful wind. Choose the speed you like, keep cool and relaxed in summer

【Portable Fan】 This evaporative cooler is only 11.4 inch height, it is very easy and convenient to carry on the go. Perfect for your bedroom, kitchen, office, dorm room, on your desktop and table top, and any other space you need cool air.
description: 1 x Personal Air Conditioner Fan 1 x DC Adapter 1 x User Manual in English

★ 3 adjustable speeds ★ A tank of water can continuously spray cooling mist for 3-5 Hours. ★ Humidification function can automatically turn-off when the tank lack of water. ★ Suitable for dressing table, dining table, study desk, office table, computer desk, etc.
Keep the personal air conditioner balance, don't tilt it when working. Adding 3/4 Water in the Tank is the best, Do Not Full Filled.
